intersection.headline: On posts record Q3 and lifts margin outlook as its Mbappé-led football push gathers pace
intersection.summary: On's Q3 sales rose 17.2% to CHF 931.4m, with apparel up sharply, and it raised its full-year gross margin outlook. Reuters links demand to celebrity collaborations, including the Kylian Mbappé football signing and Thierry Henry as director of football. Shares fell about 7.5% on concerns that US tariff refunds flattered the profit. Reports also mention a China controversy involving Mbappé.

sports.headline: Noskova upsets Gauff at WTA Finals as Rybakina's absence opens up Indian Wells
sports.summary: Wimbledon champion Linda Noskova beat Coco Gauff on Tuesday to reach the semi-finals of the WTA Finals. Top seed Elena Rybakina withdrew on Sunday with illness and fatigue. Aryna Sabalenka and Mirra Andreeva meet on Wednesday with a semi-final place in reach. The event runs to 15 November.

sports.headline: Kamario Taylor lands $7.5m deal to return to Mississippi State
sports.summary: ProFootballTalk reports that the college football player's $7.5m return deal sets a new bar for pay in the college game. It is part of a wider shift in how college athletes are paid.

sports.headline: Rugby League World Cup finals set: Kangaroos name side for Brisbane decider as Kiwi Ferns eye Jillaroos
sports.summary: Australia coach Kevin Walters has named his team to face New Zealand in the final at Suncorp Stadium on Sunday. In the women's final, the Kiwi Ferns say they can exploit the Jillaroos' 'cracks and flaws'.

sports.headline: College Football Playoff rankings: Georgia No. 1, Ohio State outside the top 10
sports.summary: The latest CFP rankings put Georgia first and leave Ohio State outside the top 10. Coaches are questioning the committee's approach and the role of conferences as the playoff expands.

sports.headline: Olympic champion Tatjana Smith switches allegiance to the Netherlands
sports.summary: Al Jazeera reports that the top South African Olympian is switching national allegiance to the Netherlands, a notable move in international swimming.

sports.headline: Stadium boom brings new pressure to deliver beyond game day
sports.summary: At Sportico's Invest New York event, Related Companies' Bruce Beal Jr. argued that new venues must anchor year-round neighbourhoods. Related is applying this at Willets Point, the future home of NYCFC's Etihad Park.

fashion.headline: Capri Holdings names Estée Lauder executive Justin Boxford as CEO
fashion.summary: The Michael Kors owner has named the beauty veteran to succeed chief executive John Idol early next year. It is a major leadership change at a global luxury group.

fashion.headline: Tod's and creative director Matteo Tamburini part ways
fashion.summary: The Italian label says it will sharpen its focus on its heritage and Italian identity after the designer's exit following nearly three years. It is the latest creative-director change at a major Italian house.

fashion.headline: Tekken x Nike Air Max 1 'Combo' collaboration set for holiday 2026
fashion.summary: Nike's .SWOOSH account has unveiled the Tekken collaboration, built around the character King, with jaguar-print detailing. It includes two Air Max 1 colourways at $160 and matching apparel. Release details are still to come.

marketing.headline: Google's AI ad losses are Meta's gain as advertisers shift budgets
marketing.summary: Google's stock fell more than 10% after its Q3 call because of slowing search ad growth, which has been blamed on its own AI Mode. Six advertisers and agency executives told The Information they have moved spend to Meta. Chatbot ad formats are also starting to multiply.

marketing.headline: Inside Waitrose's six-minute Christmas rom-com
marketing.summary: Waitrose is treating its Christmas marketing like a film release. Its top marketer explains how the 'multi-dimensional campaign' ties back to the overarching brand platform.

marketing.headline: Volvo and Eden Project turn plant data into music for Sky Nature sponsorship
marketing.summary: An unconventional sponsorship activation that uses plant data to create music for Sky Nature.
